thread:
Priya Nair: Taking primary for the 10:00-18:00 UTC shift. Primary=Priya, Secondary=@Luca Park. Leaving notes below for any incoming pages. :wave:

Luca Park: ACK. I'll be secondary and reachable on pager + mobile. Any immediate customer-facing incidents?

Priya Nair: Nothing currently paged, but two items to flag: 1) intermittent increased tail latency for text-gen on model-svc-prod in eu-west-1 (alerts flapping last 30m). 2) a partial KV cache miss pattern after the 03:00 deploy — potential cold-start storm.

Jae Kim: Thanks — can you paste runbook links for those? Also callouts for customer impact so support knows what to tell customers.

Priya Nair: Runbooks: KV cache cold starts -> <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-coldstart|kv-cache-coldstart>. Latency SLO troubleshooting -> <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-triage|latency-triage>. Quick play: scale model-svc-prod pool and enable fallback to quantized variant if latency > 300ms for 2m.

Priya Nair: Quick mitigation commands (run on ops bastion, prefer `ops` role):
```
# scale replicas for eu-west-1 model pool
redwoodctl scale --env prod --region eu-west-1 --pool model-svc-prod --replicas 6
# force fallback policy for high-latency short-circuit
redwoodctl policy set-fallback --env prod --model-group text-gen --variant quantized --threshold 300ms
```

ops-bot: Deploy bot detected: Recent deploy 03:02 UTC to model-svc-prod (deploy-id: d-9a8f). No automated rollbacks. :information_source:

Priya Nair: So root cause unknown, but pattern matches KV cache churn after the deploy. If pages spike, do a staged rollback of d-9a8f (coord with infra).

Luca Park: I'm going to warm up the KV cache for the top 10 hot prefixes and watch tail lat. Quick script I'll run in parallel: `kv-warm --env prod --region eu-west-1 --top 10`.

Jae Kim: Support note for customers: "We are investigating intermittent latency on text generation in EU. Short-term mitigations are in place; if you see errors or slow responses, please include request IDs and timestamps. Estimated update within 60 minutes." Sam, can you confirm you'd send that to active P0 customers if we see >5% error rate?

Sam (support): Yep, ready. I'll hold the template and send on your 👍. Also will open a ticket linking root runbook.

Priya Nair: Triage checklist for whoever gets paged:
1) Check alert stream: `grafana/alerts -> alert=gen-latency-eu`
2) Check model pool size & stalls: `kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=model-svc-prod`
3) Confirm recent deploy id via ops-bot and compare to rollout tags
4) If KV miss rate >10% for 5m, run warm script and scale replicas
5) If latency persists after scale+warm for 10m, enable fallback variant (see command above)
6) Engage infra on rollback only if traffic impact >20% or error rate >3%

incident-bot: Pager triggered: gen-latency-eu at 2619991500 (severity: warn).

Priya Nair: Received pager. Starting live mitigation now: scaling pool to 6 replicas (running command), launching `kv-warm` for top prefixes.

Luca Park: I'm watching traces in Jaeger, creating filter for `model-svc-prod -> text-gen` and looking for slow ops. Also verifying GPU saturation across hosts.

Jae Kim: Noted a small spike in 503s from the edge (cdn->api) around 2619991405. Could be downstream backpressure. Priya, consider ratelimiting non-critical customers if it gets worse.

Priya Nair: Agreed. I'll add a temporary rate-limit policy for low-priority API keys (5rps) if error rate climbs. Command: `redwoodctl quotas set --env prod --group low-priority --rps 5 --duration 30m`

Sam (support): Update: No customer escalations yet. I'm standing by on the P0 list. Will provide status to PMs at +30m.

ops-bot: Action logged in incident tracker (INC-2026). Mitigations: scale + warm started by Priya, fallback ready.

Priya Nair: Update after 6 minutes: tail latency median improved from 420ms -> 220ms; error rate down to 1.1%. Keeping watch for 15 more minutes.

Luca Park: GPU saturation normalized after scaling. Trace samples show longer model forward passes during cold cache windows — warming is helping.

Jae Kim: Leaving two follow-ups for the next primary shift: 1) add KV warm jobs to autoschedule after any deploy for 20 minutes, 2) add synthetic traffic for critical prefixes in eu-west-1 to detect regressions earlier.

Priya Nair: Agree on both. I'll file infra tickets and drop links in the runbook. Also documenting the quick commands in runbook note under the "Immediate mitigations" section.

Sam (support): I'll add a short customer-facing blurb to the status page if we see another alert. For now status: monitoring.

Priya Nair: Handing off at 18:00 UTC to @Luca Park. Keythings to watch: alert gen-latency-eu, ops-bot deploy notices, KV cache miss rate. If you need escalation to infra, tag @infra-oncall and ping me via DM. :thumbsup:

Luca Park: Taking over. Thanks Priya — sending an ack in case of any follow-up pages.

Priya Nair: End of thread: final state at 18:12 UTC — mitigations held, incident downgraded to advisory. Will update runbook with commands and warm script link."
